name: ats-job-feed
title: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday Jobs Scraper API
description: Scrape open jobs from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and Workday career sites into clean JSON or CSV. Filter by keyword, location or remote. New jobs only mode on a daily schedule pays just for fresh postings. $0.0015 per job; 20 jobs cost $0.03005.
